status: read-only source color audit; no visual preview or artistic acceptance performed

method.coordinates: Absolute source-atlas XY, half-open ROI endpoints; frameRect is XYWH from current manifest. No rescale or compositing for measurement.

roiDefinition.wineBody: whole frame width, y=.20h..56h of manifest crop
roiDefinition.blueBiasedSleeveCandidate: whole frame width, y=.17h..48h of manifest crop

method.interiorMask: alpha>=250 then scipy.ndimage.binary_erosion, 3x3 connectivity-default cross, 2 iterations
method.colorSpace: Stored RGB treated as sRGB because no embedded gAMA/sRGB/iCCP/cHRM. Pillow ImageCms sRGB -> Lab D50. L* from 8bit Lab /255*100, signed a/b bytes decoded. HSV from Pillow 8bit HSV; hue circular mean.
method.comparison: Median of each phase median; compare each direction separately with its idle. deltaE76 is Euclidean difference of these masked median Lab vectors; not CIEDE2000 or a paired-pixel perceptual proof.
limitations: ROIs are geometric upper-torso bands, not hand-traced garment semantic masks; sleeve candidates can include pauldron/metal or other blue-biased low-chroma fabric.
Red selection can include warm red leather straps or shaded red cloth. Belt/skin are reduced by hue selection but cannot be guaranteed absent without local visual review.
Shoulder/arm pose, chest perspective, folds, sword occlusion and baked lighting vary by phase; distributions do not identify intrinsic albedo independently of shading.
Very low sleeve chroma makes hue unstable; judge L*, RGB/chroma and local visual appearance together.
No image was opened through view_image, browser, computer vision upload or remote image service; no visual acceptance claim.

pipelineFindings.runtimeMaterial: FlatActors.ts137..144 builtin-unlit technique1, USE_TEXTURE, same root alphaThreshold, mainColor WHITE; shadows disabled. show() changes current mesh/texture/UPP only. No per-action tint/gamma field.
pipelineFindings.importScripts: install-locomotion.py copies PNG bytes with shutil.copyfile and validates hashes; install-head-alignment.py reuses transaction.install and preserves UPP/timing/direction/material fields. No pixel repaint, gamma transform, or PNG reencode.
